user.title: Lemur Light Effect Card
user.description: Adds the effect card to your dashboards and stores shared favorites, room light selections and custom icons. No settings needed.

play.name: Play effect
play.description: Plays an effect (or one of your own effects) in a room, like a tap on the card.

room.name: Room
room.description: Area ID or name of the room as the card shows it. "_all" is the whole home.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: Effect name as the light calls it, its name on the card, or the name of one of your own effects.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Optional fade time in seconds (lights that support it).

stop.name: Stop effects
stop.description: Does what the Stop button does: ends the effects in a room and goes back to a calm white.

room.name: Room
room.description: Area ID or name of the room as the card shows it. "_all" is the whole home.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Optional fade time in seconds (lights that support it).

list_effects.name: List effects
list_effects.description: Returns the effects a room can play and the one playing now.
